assistant_history.text: I want to kill myself

If you are feeling overwhelmed, hopeless, or having thoughts of self-harm or suicide, please know that you are not alone and compassionate support is available right now. Your life has immense value, and there are trained professionals ready to listen and help without judgment.

**Immediate Free & Confidential Helplines:**

• **India (National):**
  - **Tele-MANAS:** Call **14416** or **1800-891-4416** (24/7, Toll-Free, Govt of India)
  - **KIRAN Mental Health Helpline:** Call **1800-599-0019** (24/7, Toll-Free)
  - **Vandrevala Foundation:** Call or WhatsApp **+91 9999 666 555** (24/7, Free)

• **United States & Canada:**
  - **988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline:** Call or text **988** (24/7, Free & Confidential)
  - **Crisis Text Line:** Text **HOME** to **741741**

• **International / Worldwide:**
  - **Befrienders Worldwide:** [https://www.befrienders.org](https://www.befrienders.org)
  - **Find A Helpline:** [https://findahelpline.com](https://findahelpline.com)

If you are in immediate physical danger, please contact your local emergency services (like 112 in India, 911 in the US) or go to the nearest emergency hospital immediately. Please reach out to one of these resources or a trusted family member or friend right now.

days.title: Road Trip from Hyderabad to Bengaluru & Central City Walk
activities: Early morning departure from Hyderabad to Bengaluru by car via NH 44 (approx. 570 km, 8-9 hours drive)
Check-in and refresh at Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru or JW Marriott Hotel Bengaluru
Evening stroll around Cubbon Park Circle to spot the famous Bengaluru Logo installation
food: Casual dinner near Hotel Paraag or in-house dining at The Capitol

days.title: Iconic Civic Landmarks & Coastal Delights
activities: Morning architectural sightseeing of Vidhana Soudha, Ambedkar statue, and the AG Office (Audit)
Visit the Statue of Mahatma Gandhi and the memorial statue honoring Bharat Ratna Sir M Vishvesvaraya
Afternoon seafood experience satisfying coastal cravings near Cubbon Park
Leisure evening relaxation around JW Marriott Hotel Bengaluru
food: Seafood lunch featuring fresh catch at Mathsyadarshini (Fish Canteen)

days.title: Temple Blessings and Return Journey to Hyderabad
activities: Morning spiritual visit to Sri Ramanjaneyaswamy Temple
Hotel checkout from Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru
Afternoon departure and scenic return car drive to Hyderabad via NH 44
food: Breakfast buffet at Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru
Highway lunch and coffee break at Anantapur highway plazas
